According to the course material, how many types of legislature are there? (answer in figures)
two

There are two types of legislature: the unicameral and the bicameral legislatures. 1.4.1 Unicameral Legislature If a country has a single legislative chamber it is called a unicameral legislature, but if on the other hand, it has two chambers or houses it is called a bicameral legislature.
